description: I lead the engineering of Orderly, a platform that runs a restaurant end to end: a customer ordering app, point-of-sale, kitchen display screens, tableside ordering, a merchant back-office, and delivery dispatch with a dedicated rider app and a desktop client. I designed the update-safe module architecture and built the Kenyan payments and compliance layer on top of it: M-Pesa, Paystack, KRA eTIMS tax integration, OTP authentication and inventory. It runs on PHP 8.3, MariaDB and Redis behind nginx and Cloudflare, with Firebase for push notifications and a shared design system across all five apps.

descriptionTitle: An AI copilot that works inside a live restaurant.
description: I built the AI layer for Orderly from scratch: a provider-agnostic engine (Anthropic Claude and OpenRouter) with an encrypted key ring, model policies, guardrails, usage metering and a full audit trail. Agents call real tools: customers can search the menu and fill their cart by chat, the kitchen can check the queue, mark items sold out, advance orders and log waste, and platform admins get merchant and feedback summaries. Background watchers flag stuck orders, payment-gateway failures, status drift and quiet merchants before anyone has to ask.

descriptionTitle: A complete e-commerce system for Crosstech
description: I developed a full-featured e-commerce system for Crosstech that streamlines both online and retail operations in Kenya. The platform integrates affiliate management, a robust POS system, inventory and order management, user management with role-based access, and seamless M-Pesa payment processing. It also supports real-time notifications, SMS updates, and is designed to scale with a mobile app planned. Built using Laravel, React, MySQL, and RESTful APIs, with integrations for M-Pesa Daraja API and SMS gateways, the system is engineered for performance, scalability, and reliability. Designed to compete with established platforms like Jumia, this solution positions Crosstech as a reliable and innovative marketplace for businesses and customers in Kenya.

Where my hardware and software work meet. A guided diagnostic wizard for electronics repair that asks adaptive questions about a faulty device, then uses Google Gemini through Genkit to suggest likely causes and fixes and summarise past diagnoses. It includes an admin dashboard for managing devices, questions, findings and AI settings, and logs every diagnosis.

descriptionTitle: Free tools for Kenyan online stores.
description: I publish plugins for the Botble CMS and e-commerce platform that anyone can use: an M-Pesa payment gateway, plus floating TikTok, Instagram and Facebook feed widgets that link shoppers straight from social video to products. Each one is configurable from the admin panel, with options for placement, size, target pages and mobile visibility.

descriptionTitle: An e-commerce marketplace for ByteDeals Kenya
description: I developed ByteDeals.co.ke as a modern e-commerce marketplace focused on electronics and lifestyle products. The platform features product catalog management, secure M-Pesa integration, order tracking, and a responsive design optimized for both web and mobile. Built with Next.js, Laravel, and REST APIs, ByteDeals is engineered for performance, scalability, and a smooth customer experience.

descriptionTitle: An online pharmacy platform for Hinata Pharmacy
description: I developed HinataPharmacy.co.ke as a specialized e-commerce platform for pharmaceuticals. It includes prescription uploads, secure M-Pesa integration, inventory tracking, and SMS notifications for order updates. Built with Laravel, Vue.js, and MySQL, the platform ensures compliance, security, and reliability while making healthcare products easily accessible online.

descriptionTitle: A real estate listing website platform for Invexia Ltd
description: Built with Laravel on PHP 8.2: a complete real estate listing platform with agent profiles and property listings.

descriptionTitle: A lifestyle e-commerce platform for Ukiyo LifeShop
description: I created UkiyoLifeShop.com as a lifestyle and wellness e-commerce platform with multi-currency support, categorized product listings, inventory management, and order tracking. Built with React, Node.js, and MongoDB, the system is designed for scalability and a global audience, ensuring smooth checkout and secure payments.

descriptionTitle: An e-commerce platform for Celebrat Kenya
description: Built with Laravel, the e-commerce website is used by the company to generate sales and manage its online store efficiently.

descriptionTitle: A website for DST Fiber LTD
description: The DST Internet website is a dynamic and user-friendly platform designed to highlight the services and offerings of the internet service provider.

descriptionTitle: A corporate website for Kenire Business Solutions
description: Built with Wordpress, the Kenire Business Solutions Ltd website is a professional platform designed to showcase the company’s services.
